text.p: These were the main headlines from Lithuania's M-1 plus radio station's news report on Tuesday at noon. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Lithuanian diplomats expect to discuss NATO expansion with U.S. deputy state seretary Ron Asmus, who arrives in Vilnius on Tuesday. The discussion is expected to focus on the U.S.-Lithuania charter.

- The spokesman for the Vilnius district prosecutor's office, Gintautas Stalnionis, said that the alleged suicide notes of Genadijus Konopliovas are not necessarily proof of suicide, though the suiside version is the most likely theory. Konopliovas was found dead with a gunshot wound to the head on Monday. He was the president of the troubled Tauras Bank.
- Parliament intends to form a committee for European affairs to strenghten parliament's role in the EU integration process.
